docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: The ICPC Case Tracking System is designed to streamline case management, allowing users to efficiently record, track, and manage cases. This guide provides step-by-step instructions on using the system effectively.

docs.title: Overview of User Roles and Access Levels
Honorable Chairman of The Commission
docs.text:
• Track cases and view upcoming cases.
  • Access lawyer information, uncharged cases, and court listings.
  • Generate and view reports for oversight.
  • View inactive lawyers for accountability.

docs.title: SA, Legal
docs.text:
• Can track cases and view upcoming cases.
  • Access to uncharged cases, courts, and inactive lawyers.
  • Generate reports for decision-making.

docs.title: RACC (Resident Anti-Corruption Commissioner)
docs.text:
• View all cases, upcoming cases, unassigned cases, and uncharged cases.
  • Manage lawyer assignments.

docs.title: Division Head (DH)
docs.text:
• Track all cases and view upcoming cases.
  • Access unassigned and uncharged cases.
  • Manage lawyer information.

docs.title: Director, Legal
docs.text:
• Comprehensive access to track cases and view upcoming cases.
  • Can add new cases and view unassigned and uncharged cases.
  • Manage lawyers and courts, including viewing inactive lawyers.
  • Generate reports for strategic analysis.

docs.title: Lawyers
docs.text:
• Track All Cases: View a detailed, sortable table of cases (Case No, Case Title, Location, Date of Creation) with a "View" button for expanded information.
  • View New Cases: Access new cases sorted by Petition Number and Date of Creation. Can add charges using a dedicated form.
  • View Upcoming Cases: Access a list of upcoming cases with export options (CSV, Excel,PDF, Print).

  • Update Court Sitting Dates: Update hearing dates, case status (Arraignment, Trial, Appeal, Struck Out, Concluded), and add comments.

  • Edit Case Details: Edit case information through a dedicated form.

  • View Courts: View, add, and search court listings.

docs.title: Data Officer
docs.text:
• Access to Dashboard for quick insights.
  • Can add new cases and update existing case details.
  • Manages users, including adding and updating user information.
  • Can view a list of upcoming cases.

docs.title: Adding a New Case (Director, Legal and Data Officers)
docs.text:
1. Click “Add Case” in the side bar menu. Here is an inline image:
  2. Step 2: Click on the “+ Add Case” button Here is an inline image:
  3. Select case type using the radio button. At this stage, the workflow forks based on the case type. Choosing Criminal Case requires a petition number while choosing Civil Case requires a suit number Here is an inline image:
  4. Enter petition number for Criminal Case or Suit number for Civil Case and click “SUBMIT” Here is an inline image:

docs.title: Assigning Cases (Directors, Division Heads, and RACCs)
docs.text:
1. Click "Add Case" in the sidebar menu. A new interface is loaded showing a table named "Add Case"
  2. On the table click “+” on the case you wish to assign to lawyer. A pop up opens.
  3. In the pop-up, select the appropriate division
  4. Next you select the lawyer you wish you to assign the case to Dashboard
  5. Click Submit to save your changes, this sends a notification mail to the lawyer.

docs.title: Updating Case Information (Lawyers)
docs.text: There are two modes of updating cases in the ICPC CTS, a lawyer can update case or edit cases, while this may sound similar, they actually do not perform the same task.

docs.title: To Update Case follow these steps:
docs.text:
1. Click My Cases in the sidebar menu, it will show a dropdown listing Criminal or Civil cases, select your case type. Dashboard
  2. In the table "List of Case" click Update Case on the entry you wish to update. Dashboard
  3. Upon clicking Update case, a form pops up and this allows you to toggle the following details; Date of Hearing, Next Hearing Date, Case Status(Drop-down: Arraignment, Trial, Appeal, Conclusion, Struck Out), Status Description and Comment. Dashboard
  4. Click on Submit to finish Updating the Case.

docs.title: To Edit Case follow these steps:
docs.text:
• Click "Edit Case Details" in the sidebar menu. A new interface is loaded showing a table named "List of Case" Dashboard
  • On the table, Click the Pen icon that corresponds to the case you wish to edit. This Pops up a form. Dashboard
  • This form allows you to toggle the following details related to the case:

• Charge Number • Court • Location • Status • Date of Sitting • Judge • Case Title • Charges Dashboard - When done editing click SUBMIT to save your changes.

docs.title: Closing a Case (Lawyers)
docs.text:
1. To close a case, click My Cases in the sidebar menu, it will show a dropdown listing Criminal or Civil cases, select your case type.
  2. In the table "List of Case" click Update Case on the entry you wish to update, this opens the Case Update form.
  3. Fill out the Case Update form, in the Case Status drop down select “Concluded Cases” Dashboard
  4. In the field “CONCLUSION TYPE” select the applicable Conclusion Type such as Summary Trial, Full Trial and Plea Bargain. Dashboard
  5. Fill out the remaining fields in the form and click SUBMIT at the end of the form to close the case.

docs.title: ICPC Case Tracking System (CTS)
docs.text:
1. How do I log in to the Case Tracking System?
  1. Open Chrome, Firefox, or Edge
  2. Go to http://10.10.7.34/index.php
  3. Enter your username and password
  4. Click Login
2. Who can add a new case?

Only Directors (Legal) and Data Officers can add new cases.

3. What is the difference between a criminal and civil case?
  • Criminal Case → Requires a petition number
  • Civil Case → Requires a suit number
4. How do I assign a case to a lawyer?
  1. Go to Add Case
  2. Select the case, then click Assign Lawyer
  3. Choose the division and lawyer, then click Submit
  4. The lawyer receives a notification email
5. What is the difference between updating and editing a case?
  • Update Case → Used to change status, hearing dates, and comments
  • Edit Case → Used to modify case details like court, judge, charges, and title
6. How do I close a case?
  1. Open My Cases → Update Case
  2. Select Concluded Cases in the dropdown
  3. Choose a Conclusion Type (Summary Trial, Full Trial, Plea Bargain)
  4. Submit to finalize closure
7. Who can view all cases?

All users can track cases, view case details, and see upcoming hearings.

8. What are 'Unassigned' and 'Uncharged' cases?
  • Unassigned Cases → Cases not yet linked to a lawyer (RACC, DH, State Head, Directors can view)
  • Uncharged Cases → New/uncharged cases (RACC, DH, State Head, Directors, Chairman, SA Legal can view)
9. How can I generate reports?
  1. Go to Reports in the sidebar
  2. Apply filters
  3. Export as PDF, Excel, CSV, Print, or Copy

(Only Chairman, SA Legal, and Directors can generate reports)

10. How do I add a new user?
  1. Go to Manage Users → Create User
  2. Fill in details, assign a password, and select roles
  3. Click Submit

(Only Data Officers can manage users)

11. How are roles and permissions managed?

A Data Officer can: - Edit profiles - Assign roles - Revoke access - Update user privileges

12. Who has the highest access level?

The Honourable Chairman has oversight privileges, including access to all reports, case listings, and inactive lawyers.

docs.title: Tracking All Cases (All Users)
docs.text:
1. To track all cases, click “Track All Cases” in the sidebar menu
  2. The interface opens up a table “All Cases” all entries have a VIEW button, click on this button to view more details of the case. Dashboard

docs.title: Viewing Upcoming Cases (All Users)
docs.text:
1. To track all cases, click “Upcoming Cases” in the sidebar menu
  2. This opens the table upcoming cases, at the end of the table you can export the list to CSV, Excel Sheets, Print to Paper and Print to PDF by clicking on the applicable button. Dashboard

docs.title: Viewing Unassigned Cases (RACC, DH, State Head, Directors)
docs.text:
1. To view unassigned cases, click UNASSIGNED CASES in the sidebar menu.
  2. This displays the Assign Case interface, on this page you can assign cases to a lawyer by clicking ASSIGN LAWYER on any case that’s unassigned. Dashboard

docs.title: Viewing Uncharged Cases (RACC, DH, State Head, Directors, Chairman, SA to the Chairman)
docs.text: To view Uncharged Cases, Click New/Uncharged Cases in the side bar menu. This would open up a new interface showing the list of New/Uncharged Cases. Dashboard

docs.title: Generating Reports (Chairman, Directors, SA Legal)
docs.text:
To generate reports, take the following steps:

  1. Click Reports in the sidebar menu. Dashboard
  2. Use the filter criteria to select the data you wish to capture, then scroll to the bottom of the page to select how you want your report to be generated. You could copy the details, export as a PDF file, Comma Separated Values (CSV), as an Excel file or Print to paper. Dashboard

docs.title: Logging in remotely
docs.text: • Before accessing the Case Tracking System (CTS), staff working remotely must first connect through the ICPC VPN Go to the VPN Setup Guide , as the application is hosted on the organization’s local server.

docs.title: Step 1: Connect to ICPC VPN (Android – OpenVPN)
docs.text:
• On your Android device, open Google Play Store.

  • Search for OpenVPN Connect (by OpenVPN Inc.) and install it.

  • Open a browser and go to https://vpn.icpc.gov.ng.

  • Click Proceed and log in with your ICPC username and password.

  • Download your VPN configuration (.ovpn) file and save it.

  • Open the OpenVPN Connect app → Tap OVPN Profile → Import Profile from File → select the downloaded .ovpn file.

  • Tap the ICPC VPN profile and enter your ICPC credentials when prompted.

  • Tap Connect. Once connected, a lock icon will appear on your device.

docs.title: Step 2: Access the CTS Login Page
docs.text:
• Open a supported web browser (Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, or Microsoft Edge).

  • Navigate to the system URL: http://10.10.7.34/index.php.

  • Enter your username and password.

  • Click Login.

docs.title: Navigating the Dashboard
docs.text:
• The dashboard provides an overview of pending, ongoing, and closed cases.

  • Use the navigation menu to access different features, such as Case Management, Reports, and User Settings.

  • Dashboard

docs.title: Adding New Users
docs.text:
1. In the side bar menu, click "MANAGE USERS". This opens up a table, "List of Users" Dashboard
  2. Click "CREATE USER". This pops up a User Registration Form.
  3. Fill the form, create password and assign roles to the user.
  4. Click SUBMIT to save your changes.

docs.title: Assigning Roles & Permissions
docs.text:
In the case tracking system, a data officer is able to Assign Roles, Revoke Access and Edit User’s Roles and Privileges. To Edit User Profiles, A data officer should take the following steps:

  1. Click “MANAGE USERS” in the side bar. This opens a table showing the list of users currently on-boarded on the system. Dashboard
  2. Click the EDIT button that corresponds to the user’s entry. This opens an editable user’s profile. Dashboard
  3. Edit the user profile
  4. Click “UPDATE USER” to save your changes.

docs.title: Conclusion
docs.text: In this user manual, we introduce the ICPC CASE TRACKING SYSTEM and all its features. We also discussed and demonstrated the function of each interface in the application. We hope you find this manual useful when working with The Case Tracking System. Viel Gluck!

docs.title: Step-by-step instructions for connecting to the ICPC VPN Portal.
Step 1: Open the VPN Portal
docs.text:
• Open a web browser and go to https://vpn.icpc.gov.ng
  • Click on 'Advanced' this displays a hidden section.
  • Click on the link "Proceed to vpn.icpc.gov.ng (Unsafe)"
  • Log in using your username and password.

docs.title: Step 2: Download the VPN Client
docs.text: • After logging in, download the Sophos Connect Client for your device (Windows or Mac).

docs.title: Step 3: Install the VPN Client
docs.text: • Run the installer on your computer. On Windows, double-click the setup file and follow the steps. On Mac, open the .dmg file and drag the app to Applications.

docs.title: Step 4: Import the VPN Configuration
docs.text: • Go back to the VPN Portal, download your connection file, and double-click it. It will open in Sophos Connect automatically.

docs.title: Step 5: Connect to ICPC VPN
docs.text:
• Open Sophos Connect, select '41.242.62.55 ', and click 'Connect'.
  • Enter your ICPC username and password when prompted.

docs.title: Step-by-Step Instructions for Connecting to the ICPC VPN Portal (Android – OpenVPN)
Step 1: Download and Install OpenVPN
docs.text:
• Go to the Google Play Store.

  • Search for OpenVPN Connect (official app by OpenVPN Inc.).

  • Download and install it on your Android device.

docs.title: Step 2: Log in to the ICPC VPN Portal
docs.text:
• Open a web browser on your phone and go to: https://vpn.icpc.gov.ng

  • Click on Advanced.

  • Click on "Proceed to vpn.icpc.gov.ng (Unsafe)"

  • Log in using your ICPC username and password.
  • Alt text

docs.title: Step 3: Download the VPN Configuration File
docs.text:
• After logging in, download the VPN configuration (.ovpn) file for your account. Alt text
  • Save it to your device (Downloads folder by default).

docs.title: Step 4: Import Configuration into OpenVPN
docs.text:
• Open the OpenVPN Connect app.

  • Tap OVPN Profile → Import Profile from File.

  • Alt text

  • Browse to your Downloads folder and select the .ovpn file.

docs.title: Step 5: Connect to ICPC VPN
docs.text:
• Once imported, tap the saved OVPN profile.

  • Enter your username and password when prompted.

  • Tap Connect.

✅ You are now connected securely to the ICPC VPN on Android.

docs.title: Step-by-Step Instructions for Connecting to the ICPC VPN Portal (Mac & iOS – OpenVPN)
Step 1: Access the VPN Portal
docs.text:
• Open Safari (or another browser) and go to https://vpn.icpc.gov.ng .

  • Click Proceed.

  • Log in with your username and password.

docs.title: Step 2: Download the VPN Configuration File
docs.text:
• After logging in, download the VPN configuration file (.ovpn) for your account.

  • On Mac, save it to your Downloads folder.

  • On iOS, choose Open in OpenVPN when prompted.

docs.title: Step 3: Install the OpenVPN Client
docs.text:
• On Mac:

  • Click the link below to download OpenVPN for MAC

  • https://openvpn.net/downloads/openvpn-connect-v3-macros.dmg

  • Download and install it.

  • On iOS (iPhone/iPad):

  • Open the App Store.

  • Search for OpenVPN Connect and install it.

docs.title: Step 4: Import the VPN Configuration
docs.text:
• On Mac: Open OpenVPN Connect, click Import Profile, and select the .ovpn file from your Downloads.

  • On iOS: When you download the .ovpn file, choose Copy to OpenVPN to import it automatically.

docs.title: Step 5: Connect to ICPC VPN
docs.text:
• Open OpenVPN Connect.

  • Select the OVPN profile.

  • Enter your username and password.

  • Tap Connect.

✅ You are now securely connected to the ICPC VPN on Mac or iOS.
